scope: Basic calcium phosphate crystals, including hydroxyapatite, in destructive joint disease.

keyRecommendations.text: Carbonated apatite, hydroxyapatite, octacalcium phosphate, tricalcium phosphate, and whitlockite are associated with osteoarthritis, calcific tendinitis, acute arthritis, and atherosclerosis.
These crystals are identified in synovial fluid of rapidly destructive osteoarthritis, illustrated by Milwaukee shoulder, and are common in cartilage at knee replacement.
Some investigators still consider articular BCP crystals innocent bystanders or markers of end-stage OA.

clinicalBottomLine: Hydroxyapatite-type BCP crystals are tied to calcific tendinitis, acute arthritis, and Milwaukee shoulder, while their causal role in end-stage OA is still debated in this paper.
notableCaveats: The paper is mechanistic as well as clinical. Barbotage technique is not its subject.
